content.hebrew: אִישׁ חָלָק יָשַׁב בִּמְגוּרֵי אָבִיו, שָׁקֵט וְשַׁאֲנָן,
content.transliteration: Ish ḥalaḳ yashav bimḡurē aviv, shaḳet vesha’anan,
content.english: The smooth man settled in his father’s [land of] sojourning, serenely and tranquilly,

content.hebrew: שָׁתוּל עַל פַּלְגֵי מָֽיִם, כְּעֵץ רָטוֹב וְרַעֲנָן,
content.transliteration: Shatul ‘al palḡē mayim, ke‘ets ratov vera‘anan,
content.english: Putting down roots along streams of water, like a tree that is moist and supple,

content.hebrew: עִם יְלָדָיו, אֲשֶׁר יוי לוֹ חָנָן,
content.transliteration: ‘im yeladav, asher Adonai lo ḥanan,
content.english: With his children, with which Adonai had graced him,

content.hebrew: קהל: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵֽתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן.   (תהלים צא:א)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Yoshev beseter ‘elyon betsel Shaddai yitlonan
content.english: Cong. He dwelled in the shadow of the High One; he took refuge in the shade of Shaddai. (Ps. 91:1)

content.hebrew: הִפְלִיא בֶן זְקֻנִים לַחֲזוֹת חֶזְיוֹנוֹת, כִּי יוי הֱעִירוֹ,
content.transliteration: Hifli ven zeḳunim laḥazot ḥezyonot, ki Adonai he‘iro,
content.english: The son who acted beyond his years wondrously saw visions, for Adonai inspired him,
content.comments: The son who acted old. Joseph.

content.hebrew: וַיְהִי הוּא מְסַפֵּר חֲלוֹם וּמַזְכִּירוֹ.
content.transliteration: Vayhi hu mesapper ḥalom umazkiro.
content.english: And he would recount and mention his dream.

content.hebrew: שְׂנֵאֽוּהוּ אֶחָיו, וְאָבִיו שָׁמַר אֶת־הַדָּבָר וְהִסְתִּירוֹ –
content.transliteration: Sene’uhu eḥav, ve’aviv shamar et haddavar vehistiro
content.english: His brothers hated him, and his father kept the matter and concealed it—

content.hebrew: קהל: אֶת־מִסְפַּר הַחֲלוֹם וְאֶת־שִׁבְרוֹ.    (שופטים ז:טו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Et mispar haḥalom ve’et shivro.
content.english: Cong. The account of the dream and its interpretation.  (Judg. 7:15)

content.hebrew: רְאוֹת שְׁלוֹם אֶחָיו הָלַךְ, גְּזֵרַת אָבִיו לְהַשְׁלִים.
content.transliteration: Re’ot shalom eḥav halakh, gezerat aviv lehashlim.
content.english: He went to see how his brothers were doing, to fulfill his father’s instruction.

content.hebrew: יָעֲצוּ אֶחָיו לְתִתּוֹ כְּאַחַד הַחֲלָלִים.
content.transliteration: Ya‘atsu eḥav letitto ke’aḥad haḥalalim.
content.english: His brothers advised to turn him into a corpse, like any other.

content.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן הִצִּילוֹ, וִיהוּדָה בְּנִיבוֹ יַרְנִין מִלִּים:
content.transliteration: Re’uven hits’tsilo vihuda benivo yarnin millim:
content.english: Reuben rescued him, and Judah spoke nasty words:

content.hebrew: קהל: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶֽנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Lekhu venimkerennu layYishme‘elim
content.english: Cong. Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites.   (Gen. 37:27)

content.hebrew: נָאֲמוּ אֶחָיו אַחֲרֵי מָכְרוּ בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּֽסֶף,
content.transliteration: Na’amu eḥav, aḥarē makheru be‘esrim kasef,
content.english: His brothers said, after selling [him] for twenty pieces of silver,

content.hebrew: לִכְרֹת בְּרִית, לְבַל יֵצֵא הַסּוֹד – "כֹּה יוי יוֹסֵף!"
content.transliteration: Likhrot berit, leval yetsē hassod – “Ko Adonai Yosef!”
content.english: That they would make a pact so the secret would not get out—“So may God continue to do!”
content.comments: So may God continue to do. An expression indicating an oath.

content.hebrew: לֹא כֵן, בַּדָּם לְרַמּוֹת אֲבִיהֶם, יָעֲצוּ בְּתֽוֹסֶף.
content.transliteration: Lo khen, baddam lerammot avihem, ya‘atsu betosef.
content.english: They took counsel, further, to deceive their father with blood, [to convince him what was] not so.

content.hebrew: קהל: לְעֶֽבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף.      (תהלים קה:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Le‘eved nimkar Yosef
content.english: Cong. He was sold as a slave, Joseph.     (Ps. 105:17)

content.hebrew: קָנָֽהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר בְּדָמִים יְקָרִים.
content.transliteration: Ḳanahu Potifar bedamim yeḳarim.
content.english: Potiphar bought him, at great cost.

content.hebrew: שָֽׂמָה עֵינֶֽיהָ אֵֽשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו לוֹ, וַתַּפְחִידֵֽהוּ בִּדְבָרִים.
content.transliteration: Sama ‘eneha eshet adonav lo, vattafḥidehu bidvarim.
content.english: [Joseph]’s master’s wife set her eyes on him, and she verbally intimidated him.

content.hebrew: וְהוּא אָמַר: "אֵיךְ אֶחֱטָא לְמַשְׁפִּיל וּמֵרִים?"
content.transliteration: Vehu amar: “Ekh eḥta lemashpil umerim?”
content.english: But [Joseph] said: “How can I sin against the One who brings [people] down and raises [them] up?”

content.hebrew: קהל: יוי מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים.     (תהלים קמו:ז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Adonai mattir asurim.
content.english: Cong. Adonai releases the bound.     (Ps. 146:7)

content.hebrew: לְבֵית הַסֹּֽהַר אֲדֹנָיו נְתָנָֽהוּ,
content.transliteration: Levet hassohar adonav netanahu,
content.english: His master put him in the prison,

content.hebrew: וְשָׁם שָׂרֵי אֲסִירֵי פַרְעֹה חֲלוֹם סִפְּרֽוּהוּ.
content.transliteration: Vesham sarē asirē far‘o ḥalom sipperuhu.
content.english: Where the imprisoned ministers of Pharaoh told him a dream.

content.hebrew: וּלְהַזְכִּירוֹ לְפַרְעֹה שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים בִּקֵּשׁ, וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵֽהוּ,
content.transliteration: Ulhazkiro lefar‘o sar hammashḳim biḳḳesh, vayyishkaḥehu,
content.english: And he asked the minister of stewards to mention him to Pharaoh, but he forgot him,

content.hebrew: קהל: עַד עֵת בֹּא דְבָרוֹ, אִמְרַת יוי צְרָפָֽתְהוּ.  (תהלים קה:יט)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: ‘ad ‘et bo devaro, imrat Adonai tserafatehu.
content.english: Cong. Until the time when his case came, [when] Adonai’s utterance brought it to completion.        (Ps. 105:19)

content.hebrew: קָרוֹב יוי לַכֹּל, אַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת קֹרְאָיו.
content.transliteration: Ḳarov Adonai lakkol, akh be’emet ḳore’av.
content.english: Adonai is close to all, as long as they call out to Him honestly.

content.hebrew: רְצוֹנָם יַעֲשֶׂה, וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לִבָּם יְאָו.
content.transliteration: Retsonam ya‘asē, vekhol asher libbam ye’av.
content.english: He carries out their will, and whatever their heart desires.

content.hebrew: אוֹתוֹת בְּכָל־יוֹם יְחַדֵּשׁ לִבְרוּאָיו,
content.transliteration: Otot bekhol yom yeḥaddesh livru’av,
content.english: He makes new wonders every day, for his creations,

content.hebrew: קהל: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו.     (תהלים פה:י)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Akh ḳarov lire’av.
content.english: Cong. Indeed, He is close to those who fear Him.   (Ps. 85:10)

content.hebrew: חזן: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ: (תהלים פה:י)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Akh ḳarov lire’av yish‘o lishkon kavod be’artsenu:
content.english: Cantor: Indeed, His rescue is close to those who fear Him, such that His Glory will dwell in our land. (Ps. 85:10)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ: (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Congregation: Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
